name: wetlab-planner-sidecar
description: WetLab Planner Express server, bundled as the Tauri api-server sidecar.
comment: Only the deps statically required by server.js + backend/pg-queries.js are listed. stripe/bcrypt/pg-native are dynamic, postgres/billing-only requires and are externalized by esbuild (see scripts/build-sidecar.sh) — they never run in the desktop file-DB build. clocklet/jsdom were unused frontend/phantom deps (the latter pulled a git-over-SSH transitive that breaks CI) and are intentionally dropped.
